name: Meta Ads
description:
Meta Ads (formerly Facebook Ads) is a comprehensive digital advertising platform that allows businesses to create, run, and track ad campaigns across Meta's entire ecosystem, which includes Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, and the Audience Network. It is designed to help go-to-market teams and advertisers reach specific audiences using highly granular targeting based on user demographics, interests, location, and behavior.

The platform offers a suite of tools for businesses of all sizes to build brand awareness, drive website traffic, generate high-quality leads, and increase conversions. With advanced machine learning capabilities—such as their Advantage+ automated campaigns—Meta Ads helps advertisers optimize their budgets, automate ad placements, and dynamically test creatives to deliver the right message to the most relevant users at scale.

name: Dealfront
description:
Dealfront is a European-first go-to-market platform built for B2B companies. Created from the merger of German sales intelligence provider Echobot and Finnish web visitor intelligence platform Leadfeeder, it unifies firmographic data, website visitor tracking, and buyer intent insights into a single revenue engine. The platform empowers sales and marketing teams to identify, prioritize, and engage high-intent prospects by turning anonymous website traffic into actionable pipeline.

Dealfront provides live data on tens of millions of companies and hundreds of millions of verified contacts, with a strong emphasis on strict GDPR compliance, EU-specific data, and localized market insights. Through integrated modules for website visitor identification, B2B prospecting, data enrichment, and display advertising, the platform helps organizations target their ideal customer profiles and accelerate their sales funnel while maintaining seamless CRM synchronization.

name: Google Postmaster
description: Google Postmaster Tools is a free analytics service provided by Google that helps high-volume email senders monitor and improve their email deliverability to Gmail and Google Workspace users. It provides detailed dashboards and insights into critical metrics such as user-reported spam rates, delivery errors, authentication status (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and encryption. Designed to help senders adhere to Google's strict bulk sender guidelines, the platform gives organizations the visibility needed to troubleshoot delivery issues and ensure their campaigns successfully reach their audiences' inboxes rather than being filtered to spam.

name: Outlook
description: Microsoft Outlook is a comprehensive personal information manager software system from Microsoft, primarily known for its widespread use as an enterprise and personal email client. Available as part of the Microsoft 365 suite or as a standalone application, Outlook seamlessly integrates email, calendaring, contact management, and task tracking into a unified platform. It is designed to serve both individual users and large organizations, offering robust security features, deep integration with other Microsoft productivity tools (such as Teams, Word, and Excel), and advanced organizational capabilities that help professionals manage their daily workflows and communications efficiently.

name: Breeze Intelligence
description:
Breeze Intelligence is HubSpot's data enrichment and buyer intent layer, built directly into the Smart CRM rather than bolted on as a separate tool. It draws on a pool of more than 200 million continually refreshed company and buyer profiles — the data assets HubSpot acquired with Clearbit — to give go-to-market teams a fuller picture of who they are selling to without adding another vendor to the stack.

It does three jobs. One-click enrichment fills in over 40 firmographic, demographic and technographic attributes on company and contact records, so reps stop working from half-empty rows. Buyer intent surfaces the high-fit companies visiting your site and researching your market, letting marketers define a target market and prioritise accounts showing real signal. Form shortening drops fields Breeze already knows the answer to, cutting abandonment while still capturing the full record behind the scenes.

name: Conversions API
description:
Conversion is the agentic marketing automation platform built for enterprises. It unifies CRM and warehouse data — Salesforce, Snowflake, BigQuery and others — into a single context layer purpose-built for marketing operations, then lets teams automate on top of it with AI agents and ship campaigns in hours rather than weeks. Around 90% of its customers moved over from a legacy platform: Marketo, Pardot, HubSpot or Iterable.

The platform covers the full MOps surface — flexible data modelling with custom objects and relationships, a drag-and-drop email builder with Liquid templating and dynamic personalisation, audience segmentation backed by a query engine, visual real-time workflow builders, forms and landing pages, A/B testing across subject lines, content and send times, and campaign reporting tied back to pipeline and revenue. Salesforce sync is bidirectional and audit-logged.

Conversion Agents take on the monotonous half of the job: MOps tickets, QA, reporting and campaign builds, run on a schedule, on a trigger or on demand, with every output staying inside the same approval framework a human would use. Customers include ClickHouse, Plaid, Webflow, Productboard, Veriforce and ACV Auctions. SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant, with SSO/SAML and role-based access control standard.

name: LinkedIn Ads
description:
LinkedIn Ads is LinkedIn's self-serve advertising platform, built around one thing no other channel offers at scale: professional context. Campaigns reach a network of over a billion members using more than 20 categories of targeting attributes — job title, function, seniority, industry, company size, skills — so B2B advertisers can put a message in front of the actual decision-maker rather than inferring intent from consumer signals.

The platform carries several formats. Sponsored Content places media-rich ads directly in the feed across devices; Sponsored Messaging delivers into members' inboxes; Text Ads are quick pay-per-click placements on desktop; and Dynamic Ads personalise creative using profile data such as a viewer's name, job title or employer. Budgets are flexible enough for a small business testing a single campaign and deep enough for agencies and enterprises running always-on demand generation, with lead generation, brand awareness and event registration as the usual objectives.

name: Gmail
description:
Gmail is Google's email service — secure, smart and easy-to-use email used by billions of people, now with Gemini built in. For go-to-market teams it is the default sending and receiving surface: the inbox outbound sequences land in, the address prospects reply to, and the account most sales tooling connects to first.

Its filtering blocks 99.9% of spam, malware and dangerous links before they reach the inbox, backed by industry-leading encryption on all messages and advanced phishing detection across more than a billion users. Gemini adds suggested replies matched to your own writing style, AI summaries of long threads, and smarter inbox search, alongside long-standing features like Smart Compose and follow-up nudges. It works offline and across devices, can pull in other accounts, and connects directly to the rest of Google Workspace — Calendar, Meet, Chat, Docs and Drive. Business plans add custom domains, more storage, guaranteed uptime and 24/7 support.
